content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ACTREC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Trial Coordinator. This is a contractual position offered by ACTREC.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Trial Coordinator post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this job?
faq.answer: The application mode for this job is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly without prior online application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 16 September 2026. Candidates should report on this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is a Graduate degree in Science (M. Pharm, Life Sciences, Biotech, Zoology, Botany etc.) with a P.G. Diploma in Clinical Research.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Trial Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 27000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location is Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 410210.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview.
